title.rendered: PUNCH Panorama: Common regrets people have as they get older

content.rendered:
As the year is gradually coming to an end, there may be many decisions you would have taken since January but you didn’t take them. Now is another time to get these decisions done.

When many people look back at their lives, they wished they did things better.

In this podcast, we list some of the common regrets people have as they get older.

Listen and share your thoughts.
